order_status.definition: Customer asks where an existing order is, when it will ship, or when it will arrive.

refund_request.definition: Customer asks for their money back for a completed purchase.

product_question.definition: Pre-purchase question about an item's specs, stock, compatibility or sizing.

return_exchange.definition: Customer wants to send an item back or swap it for another size or colour.

damaged_item.definition: The item arrived broken, torn, cracked or malfunctioning out of the box.

payment_issue.definition: Problems paying or being paid: card declines, duplicate charges, checkout errors, unapplied refunds.

cancel_order.definition: Customer wants to cancel an existing order that has not been delivered yet.

wrong_item.definition: Customer received something other than what they ordered: wrong size, colour or entirely different product.

account_access.definition: Trouble logging in: forgotten password, locked account, missing reset emails, verification loops.

shipping_address_change.definition: Customer wants the delivery address changed before the order ships.

other.definition: Anything that does not fit the other eleven categories: gift cards, loyalty points, partnerships, legal notices, feedback about websites.

complaint_escalation.definition: Customer is angry at how their case has been handled and asks for a manager, a supervisor or a human decision.
